queue_status.cmd: docker exec knowledge_postgres psql -U admin -d knowledge_os -c "SELECT status, count(*) FROM tasks GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;"

stale_tasks.cmd: docker exec knowledge_postgres psql -U admin -d knowledge_os -c "SELECT count(*) AS stale_in_progress FROM tasks WHERE status='in_progress' AND updated_at < now() - interval '30 minutes';"

failure_1h.cmd: docker exec knowledge_postgres psql -U admin -d knowledge_os -c "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed') AS failed, count(*) AS total, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed')/NULLIF(count(*),0),2) AS failed_pct FROM tasks WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';"

failure_6h.cmd: docker exec knowledge_postgres psql -U admin -d knowledge_os -c "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed') AS failed, count(*) AS total, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed')/NULLIF(count(*),0),2) AS failed_pct FROM tasks WHERE created_at > now() - interval '6 hours';"
